channel.title: Paksh: International
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Officials Meet to Discuss Ending Ukraine War
item.description: Officials from the United States, Ukraine, and Europe convened to discuss ending the war in Ukraine. The meeting's purpose was to explore pathways toward peace, with a focus on a united European approach to regain control of the situation. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ukraine Strikes Russian Oil Refineries, Impacting Capacity
item.description: Ukraine launched strikes targeting nine Russian oil refineries, resulting in a reported 30% reduction in refining capacity. Russian cruise missiles were observed over Europe during the period of these strikes. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Israel Unveils New 'Super Ice' Missile with Long Range and AI Navigation
item.description: Israel has launched its new 'Super Ice' missile, featuring a range exceeding 300 kilometers and equipped with AI navigation. Rafael unveiled the missile, which is intended to surprise adversaries in future conflicts. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump's Gaza peace plan emphasizes Hamas disarmament, criticizes Israel's pace
item.description: Israel has backed a 20-point plan proposed by former U.S. President Donald Trump for the reconstruction of Gaza, which includes the non-negotiable disarmament of Hamas. Trump's "Board of Peace" has warned of an "immediate humanitarian… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Yemen Airstrikes Kill 44 Amid Intensified Saudi-Houthi Conflict
item.description: A Saudi-led coalition announced it destroyed Houthi missile facilities in Yemen. The coalition's airstrikes in Yemen resulted in 44 deaths, including women and children, as the conflict between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis intensifies. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi yield prisoner exchange
item.description: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a prisoner exchange following talks in Abu Dhabi. The negotiations, which involved US mediation, concluded with the agreement on the exchange, though no broader breakthrough was reported. Ukrainian… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 12 · Right 1.

item.title: Russian forces reinforced positions during Oleshky ceasefire
item.description: Russian military forces utilized a ceasefire in Oleshky to reinforce their troops, hardware, and supplies around the city. Reports indicate that during this period, there was no access to basic needs for residents, and the ceasefire… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Saudi Coalition Conducts Operation Against Houthi Resources
item.description: The Saudi-led coalition announced it conducted an operation to neutralize vital Houthi resources in Yemen. Footage of military strikes on Houthi sites was released. Separately, a new Saudi luxury airline reportedly faced flight… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Iran Warns of Extended Conflict Amid US Threats
item.description: Iran has warned that any new war with the United States could last longer, with officials stating they would not announce attacks in advance. This comes after US President Trump claimed to have "knocked out much of Iran's military." Amid… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 11 · Right 4.

item.title: US Approves Patriot Missile Sale to Ukraine Amid Shortages
item.description: The United States has approved a proposed $2.1-billion sale of Patriot interceptor missiles to Ukraine. This sale comes after reports that Ukraine has run out of these interceptor missiles, which are crucial for its air defense… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Gulf States Fear Iran Retaliation Amid US Strike Preparations
item.description: Gulf states are concerned about intensified retaliation from Iran should the United States launch further strikes. This fear comes as Iran is perceived to be buying time in nuclear negotiations while the U.S. prepares for potential… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Israeli Fire Kills Four in Gaza Amid Ceasefire
item.description: Israeli forces opened fire in Gaza, resulting in the deaths of at least four people, according to health officials and medics. The incident occurred amidst a fragile ceasefire. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US proposes rule to curb tech investments in China, adversaries
item.description: The U.S. Treasury has proposed a new rule aimed at restricting high-tech investments in China and other nations identified as 'countries of concern.' This initiative seeks to prevent adversaries from acquiring sensitive American… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian Embassies Issue Safety Advisories Amid Unrest and Tensions
item.description: Indian embassies in France and Saudi Arabia have issued safety advisories for citizens. The advisory in France comes amid civil unrest and local curfews, while the one in Riyadh addresses concerns related to Gulf tensions. The specific… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Sudha Murty calls for global pact on outer space arms race
item.description: Sudha Murty has called for a legally binding international agreement to prevent an arms race in outer space, stating that outer space belongs to everyone. India has also urged for a binding global pact to achieve this goal. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: India-Singapore Naval Exercise SIMBEX-2026 Begins in Visakhapatnam
item.description: The 33rd edition of the Singapore-India Maritime Bilateral Exercise (SIMBEX-2026) has commenced in Visakhapatnam. The exercise, which will be conducted in two phases until October 26, marks a milestone in the maritime partnership between… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Ukraine's Funding Dependent on US Support, European Capacity Questioned
item.description: The ongoing support for Ukraine is significantly tied to the United States, with one report highlighting that Ukraine's existence is contingent on US backing. Current US support for Ukraine has evolved. Meanwhile, questions are being… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Israel Flies Warplanes Near Iran Border Despite US Hesitation
item.description: Dozens of Israeli fighter jets flew near the Iranian border, a show of military strength intended to deter Iran from an attack. The action, however, raised concerns about a potential Iranian counter-response and the risk of renewed… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Macron's Gulf Visit Focuses on Energy and Security
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron is undertaking a three-day visit to Gulf states, with discussions centered on energy and security. A diplomat stated that France "has to assist" Gulf nations, suggesting a focus on forging a future where… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Qatar Announces New Regional Defence Partnership Amid Gulf Tensions
item.description: Qatar is set to announce a new regional defense partnership amidst ongoing Gulf tensions. The nation also warned that the peak of an energy crisis may be approaching. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Bulgaria seeks NATO anti-drone systems amid Black Sea tensions
item.description: Bulgaria has requested anti-drone systems from NATO, according to its defence minister. This request comes amid heightened fears of Russian escalation in the Black Sea, following drone strikes that could test NATO's response capabilities… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Iran Increases Attacks on Shipping Amid US War Threat
item.description: Iran is reportedly shifting tactics to increase attacks on shipping, with officials suggesting this is happening before the US vote. This comes as Iran fights a spike in militant attacks domestically, occurring as a US war threat looms… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 14 · Right 0.

item.title: India expresses deep concern over Middle East hostilities at UNSC
item.description: India has conveyed its deep concern over the escalation of hostilities in the Middle East to the United Nations Security Council (UNSC). The country strongly condemned repeated attacks on civilian infrastructure, including Saudi airports… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: US Holds Secret Talks with Myanmar's Rulers Over Rare Earths
item.description: The United States has held secret talks with Myanmar's military-backed rulers, with sources indicating the discussions took place in Tokyo. The meetings, described as 'unusual' by one report, focused on strategic interests in rare earth… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: US Destroys Iran-Affiliated Boat in Gulf of Oman
item.description: The U.S. military destroyed an Iran-affiliated boat in the Gulf of Oman, stating it conducted surveillance and targeted the navy. The U.S. military evacuated the crew before destroying the vessel. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump claims Iran war could end soon
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump stated that a war with Iran would end "very soon" and "soon as I want it to end." The statements were made without providing further details on the context or specific plans. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
